summary: Static staged-diff review passed with no concrete frontend/UX security or logic blocker. Mode, project/workspace/layer scope is passed explicitly to drawing; scene saves use revision CAS, generation guards, in-memory per-scope drafts, and explicit discard/reload recovery. Read-only controls are disabled both at the host and drawing/map surface; Excalidraw embeds/files/images are restricted and link opening is prevented. The map projects graph data and exports generated Archify JSON separately from drawings; settings are validated browser-local preferences and are wired to visible grid/snap behavior. Lazy loading and local font copying are configured for the drawing asset path. Reviewed the requested staged sources and E2E specs without server/browser/network activity. git diff --cached --check and npm exec -- tsc --noEmit exited 0; E2E was inspected, not executed.
